_comment: Tier-2 for dune::stokes#1 and dune::navier_stokes#5. Taylor-Hood (P2 velocity, P1 pressure) Poiseuille flow on an 8x8 grid, 659 dofs, linear.tolerance 1e-12; wall time 269 s on 2026-08-06 (dune-fem 2.12.0.2), dominated by the composite-space builds. Measured: solver=('suitesparse','umfpack') reports linear_iterations 1; cg converges in 651, gmres in 25123, bicgstab in 9297 — ALL THREE CONVERGE, which is the retraction the catalog already carries, and their solutions sit 2.068e-12, 3.188e-10 and 9.375e-11 relative to the direct one. So the signal is cost and accuracy, not failure. The default preconditioner is 'none': passing it explicitly reproduced the default gmres count EXACTLY (25123 both ways), while 'ssor' cut it to 2027 and 'jacobi' to 8102. ASSERTION POLICY: iteration counts are asserted by ORDER OF MAGNITUDE only (direct == 1, worst Krylov > 1000x that). The catalog itself records that an earlier revision's six digits did not reproduce, and these numbers are grid- and tolerance-dependent — do not pin them.
